مَأْرُوضٌ Wood eaten by the أَرَضَة [or woodfretter, or termite, but generally meaning the former]; (S, A, Msb, K;) as also ↓ أَرْضٌ . (TA.) ＝
-A2- A person affected with خَبَل [q. v.] from the jinn, or genii, and [what are called] أَهْلُ الأَرْضِ, (S, K,) i. e. (so accord. to the S and TA, but in the K “ and ”) he who moves about his head and body involuntarily. (S, K.) ―
-b2- A person affected with زُكَام [or rheum]: (S, K:) accord. to Sgh, [who seems, like J, not to have known أُرِضَ,] from آرَضَهُ; (Sgh, TA;) whereas by rule, [if from آرِضَهُ,] it should be مُؤْرَضٌ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
